pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Infracost shows cloud cost estimates for Terraform, Terragrunt, and CloudFormation before changes are deployed, in the terminal, in editors, and in pull requests.
This is the v2 CLI (github.com/infracost/cli), a from-scratch rewrite of the original infracost/infracost project. `infracost scan` and `infracost ci setup` require an Infracost Cloud organization (`infracost auth login` or `infracost setup`); a static `INFRACOST_CLI_PRICING_API_KEY` against a self-hosted Cloud Pricing API disables login, dashboard, and telemetry communication with Infracost Cloud. This does not by itself make operation fully offline: plugin downloads from releases.infracost.io and the background CLI version check (below) still occur unless separately disabled.
The CLI downloads and auto-updates parser/provider plugins at runtime into "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}"/infracost (set INFRACOST_CLI_PLUGIN_AUTO_UPDATE=false to stop plugin auto-updates; missing plugins are still fetched on first use). Login state and other configuration are stored separately under "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}"/infracost. Every invocation, including plain --version/--help, fires a non-blocking background check against releases.infracost.io for a newer CLI version (cached for 24h; set INFRACOST_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK to disable).
The CLI has its own `infracost update` self-updater, which is unaware of Portage and will overwrite this package's /usr/bin/infracost in place (falling back to a sudo-elevated copy if not run as root) -- do not run it on a Portage-managed install; use Portage to upgrade this package instead.
This package installs the binaries published in upstream releases.
